title: Sanjay Mishra v. State of U.P. and 2 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Vivek Kumar Singh, JJ.
disposition: Second respondent to take Supply Code remedial measures within six weeks
headnote: On a pending representation alleging excessive electricity bills and seeking meter replacement and installment of dues, the High Court directed the second respondent to take remedial measures under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, preferably within six weeks of production of a certified copy, without deciding the bill, the meter, or installments.
facts: Sanjay Mishra, a practising advocate of the Allahabad High Court, was undergoing cancer treatment at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai, at a stated expense of about Rs 30 lakh. He alleged that the electricity department had continuously raised bills of more than Rs 4,000 a month. An application dated 27 November 2018 for inspection and replacement of the meter was not acted upon by respondent no. 3. A representation dated 19 September 2022, asking for a meter change and permission to pay the dues in installments, was still pending.

holding_units.topic: Remedial measures on a pending billing and meter representation
holding_units.holding: The second respondent must take remedial measures under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, on the representation dated 19 September 2022, expeditiously and preferably within six weeks of production of a certified copy. The direction follows the licensee's statement that such measures would be taken under the Code. The Court did not decide whether the bills were excessive, whether the meter must be replaced, or whether the dues may be paid in installments.
holding_units.flag: The petitioner invoked 'Section 5.6' of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The operative direction does not apply that number, and the Code is framed in clauses rather than sections.

principle_tags.application: A pending representation complaining of excessive bills and seeking meter replacement and installment of dues is to be met by remedial measures under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within a court-fixed outer limit, without a merits finding on the bill.

not_decided.point: Whether the monthly bills were excessive, whether the meter had to be replaced, and whether the dues could be paid in installments
not_decided.note: Left to remedial action under the Supply Code on the representation dated 19 September 2022.

not_decided.point: Meaning and application of the petitioner's 'Section 5.6' of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The Court directed measures under the Code at large and did not construe that number.
